s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal distention and pelvic mass with complex features
salient_findings: Multiloculated complex pelvic mass with thick septations on ultrasound
key_facts: Prior cesarean section with bilateral tubal ligation
Abdomen was distended and diffusely tender on examination
Pelvic examination revealed a 30cm left adnexal mass
Uterus was small and difficult to palpate

shortlist.label: Ovarian serous cystadenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated CA-125 and complex pelvic mass

shortlist.label: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Abdominal distention and pelvic mass with complex features

shortlist.label: Primary peritoneal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse abdominal tenderness and elevated CA-125

shortlist.label: Ovarian endometrioid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Pelvic mass and history of prior surgeries

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with a large, complex pelvic mass, elevated CA-125, and a history of worsening abdominal distention and tenderness is most consistent with ovarian serous cystadenocarcinoma, which is a common and aggressive subtype of ovarian cancer.

rejected.label: Ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
rejected.why: Less common and typically presents with a large, mucinous mass, which is not described in this case

rejected.label: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with a solid mass and is less common than serous cystadenocarcinoma

rejected.label: Primary peritoneal carcinoma
rejected.why: Would not typically present with a large, complex adnexal mass

rejected.label: Ovarian endometrioid carcinoma
rejected.why: Less common and often associated with endometriosis, which is not mentioned in this case
